name: Ogero Data Centers (Ras Beirut / Bir Hassan)
notes: Two Ogero data center facilities at Ras Beirut/Bir Hassan (Beirut) fully installed and commissioned by ESS: Liebert N+N precision cooling, FM200 fire suppression, environmental monitoring, access control, raised floor; first phase 15 racks with expansion provision. DCD (Aug 2021) documents Ogero running these facilities on backup generators during Lebanon's diesel/fuel crisis, confirming their operation. No public MW capacity figure.

name: Ogero National Datacenter (PPP proposal)
developer: Ogero / Ministry of Telecommunications (public-private partnership; anchor tenants MIC1-Alfa, MIC2-Touch, Ogero)
notes: National data center announced by Ogero in 2018 as 'the first datacenter in Lebanon' (planned location Beirut area, not officially specified). Services planned: colocation-as-a-service, cloud, and disaster recovery. By Feb 2019 the PPP proposal was under final review by the privatization commission with execution expected spring 2019. No public evidence of construction after Lebanon's 2019+ economic crisis; status likely stalled/unbuilt.

name: Sodetel Data Center / Hosting Infrastructure (Jounieh)
notes: Sodetel, Lebanon's private ISP based in Jounieh (Keserwan district, Mount Lebanon Governorate), operates its own data/network center infrastructure (AS31126) with local, nodal and international redundancy and offers hosting/colocation services. Evidence is weak (hosting directory listing); treated as an ISP-operated facility rather than a public commercial datacenter project. No public MW capacity figure.
No public datacenter project or operational facility found in Akkar (Halba, Qoubayat are Ogero telecom central offices only; DCD 2021 outage report references them as exchanges, not datacenters).
